data.one_liner: Shared Dart structures and server classes between devtools_app and other tools.
data.what_it_does: Provides shared data structures, memory structures collected from the Dart VM, ADB memory info, and shared DevTools server classes.
use_when: You are building tools that need to consume or interoperate with Dart DevTools shared structures.
You need shared DevTools server implementation classes.
avoid_when: You are building a standard mobile or web application unrelated to Dart DevTools tooling.
strengths: Maintained by the Flutter team as part of DevTools.
Standardizes structures between devtools_app, dds, and external tooling.
weaknesses: Not intended for general application development use.
